method: Walked the album page lightbox on a local dev server (localhost:5198, album DWdCET): opening a photo requests /api/hdr/<photo_id> for it and the preloaded neighbour, and on 404 (no local R2 binding) shows the Cloudflare Images large copy; navigating right retried HDR for the next photo. No visible text changed: only the image source choice. Live /api/hdr/DWdCET-DSC09484 serves a 1067x1600 Ultra HDR JPEG (hdrgm 1.0, decodes with ultrahdr_app).
